scenarios.label: Find usages
scenarios.prompt: Find every place in the project where {name} is used. Group them by file, give each one as `path:line` with what it is used for there, and say where it is defined. Do not change any files.

scenarios.label: Update docs
scenarios.prompt: Update the documentation to match the code changes: look at the uncommitted changes and the last commits with git, find the README and docs sections they make outdated, and edit them. Then list what you changed and why.

scenarios.label: Generate CHANGELOG
scenarios.prompt: Write CHANGELOG.md for this project from its git history: newest first, grouped by date or version into Added / Changed / Fixed, one line per change in plain words. If CHANGELOG.md already exists, add what is missing instead of rewriting it.

scenarios.label: Write an ADR
scenarios.prompt: Write an architecture decision record for {decision}: read the code and docs it concerns, then create docs/adr/NNNN-<short-title>.md (the next free number) with Context, Decision, Consequences and Alternatives considered.

scenarios.label: Check the rules
scenarios.prompt: Check the project against its rules (the project's instructions file, or its contributing or style guide). For every rule say whether it holds, and list each violation as `path:line` with the rule it breaks. Do not fix anything yet.
